On the detail view of RD-1017 ('fwrd76-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Bench Ticket') I opened "Add part" and saved a second part named exactly 'fwrd76-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part B' with Cost 200, Markup % 25, Quantity 1, Supplier "Bench Supplier". The detail view refreshed and the Parts table now lists both parts: 'fwrd76-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A' $100.00 / 25% / qty 1 / $125.00 and 'fwrd76-n2 RD Bench Ticket RD Part B' $200.00 / 25% / qty 1 / $250.00 (price computed by the app), with the Total (price × quantity) row now reading $375.00.

Edited 'fwrd76-n2 RD Part A' on ticket RD-1017 via the row's Edit button, changed Cost from 100 to 150 (Markup left at 25) and clicked "Save part". The Edit dialog closed and the detail view refreshed: the part row now reads Name 'fwrd76-n2 RD Part A', Cost $150.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1, Supplier Bench Supplier, Price $187.50 (app-computed), and the Total (price × quantity) row is now $437.50 (Part A $187.50 + Part B $250.00).

I attempted the status change to "Ready" on ticket RD-1017 by clicking the "Mark Ready" button. The app did not refuse it: no error, alert, hint or validation message appeared at any point, and there are no disabled controls explaining a precondition. The status badge changed from "Draft" to "Ready" and the action buttons became "Mark Draft" + "Mark Closed" (the "Mark Ready" button disappeared). I confirmed persistence with a full page reload: the detail view reads "Status Ready". Final state observed: RD-1017, heading 'fwrd76-n2 RD Bench Ticket', "Customer: Bench Customer · Raised 2026-09-17", Status Ready, buttons Mark Draft / Mark Closed / Archive ticket; Parts table rows 'fwrd76-n2 RD Part A' $150.00 / 25% / qty 1 / $187.50 and 'fwrd76-n2 RD Part B' $200.00 / 25% / qty 1 / $250.00, Total (price × quantity) $437.50.

Created probe ticket RD-1018 titled exactly 'fwrd76-n2 RD Probe Ticket RD Probe Ticket' with Customer 'Bench Customer' (only required fields; no parts) via the tickets list's "New ticket" dialog, then opened its detail view at http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t16 and clicked "Mark Ready" without changing anything else. The app refused: it raised a native browser alert (captured and dismissed by the tooling) reading verbatim "Ticket is not ready\n\nA ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready", and an in-page role=alert banner with the same text appeared on the detail view. The status badge still reads "Draft" and the Mark Ready button is still present. The probe ticket's Parts table shows "No parts on this ticket yet." No workaround was attempted.
